request.text:
labels: A nearby classmate's shoulder and back of head occupy one foreground edge, while the other student's face remains visible beyond them across the desk.; 가까운 동급생의 어깨와 뒤통수가 전경 한쪽을 차지하고 그 너머 책상 건너 다른 학생의 얼굴이 보인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A nearby classmate's shoulder and back of head occupy one foreground edge, while the other student's face remains visible beyond them across the desk.
aliases: 오버숄더의 전경과 대상
